high_level_description: This image shows a large billboard advertisement for Chanel's "N°5 L'Eau" perfume. The billboard is prominently displayed on the side of a building, with a clear blue sky in the background, suggesting it was taken during the daytime under sunny conditions. The billboard features a woman sitting on the ground, wearing a black outfit and smiling. She appears relaxed and confident. The perfume bottle is depicted twice on the billboard: once on the left side, showing the front view of the bottle, and once on the right side, showing the back view.
